description: Open an idle architecture view in the Hudson Kit Arc studio. Open the returned liveUrl once; use begin_live_diagram_work before doing diagram work, update_live_diagram for full revisions, and finish_live_diagram_work when that work ends. Keep stable node IDs for continuous motion. Connection identity comes from MCP initialization; optional agent labels are caller-declared.

agent.description: Optional display identity for this session; preserves the actual MCP client name, version, and connection ID

harness.description: Caller-declared harness label, for example Codex; not inferred or verified by Arc

baseUrl.description: Studio base URL (default: ARC_EDITOR_URL or http://localhost:5188)

title.description: Human-readable title for the live architecture

name: open_live_diagram
